title: Guesthouse loft apartment in East Nashville
description:
This East Nashville loft has everything you need for a comfortable adventure in Music City. Cozy and bright, the space is newly built and has all the amenities you'll need for a home away from home. Located in the Cleveland Park neighborhood you are in walking distance to great restaurants, coffee shops, and just a short ride away (about 3 miles) from Downtown. With two bedrooms this loft is perfect for both a family getaway or for staying with friends.

The space
This beautiful loft offers a private entrance to a new two bedroom space in East Nashville.

Guest access
The entire loft is open to you for your stay.

Other things to note
Please note that this is a loft space above a garage, and has a full flight of stairs inside the unit.
